svg.title: Relative inputs and temporary provider overrides
svg.desc: Two new module-specific regressions verify absolute input resolution and real .clang-tidy discovery, and restoring a temporarily overridden provider.
svg.text: Relative inputs and temporary provider overrides
New tests protect filename resolution at the module boundary and configuration restoration after timing.
No module-specific tests for these cases in the parent.
Relative input: the new listener derives the filename
from CompilerInstance, rather than ParsedAST's path.
Temporary provider: swapProvider is a new module API
used to override and restore check-mode configuration.
// CommandMangler normally makes inputs absolute. Direct frontend inputs
// must also be normalized relative to the compilation directory.
// Check-mode timing temporarily overrides tidy's configuration, then
// restores the original provider for subsequent builds.
Relative input: resolve src/./test.cpp from the compilation directory; verify the selected .clang-tidy check runs.
Temporary provider: disable checks, swap back, and verify modernize-use-nullptr is restored.
Colors follow git diff · unchanged context is gray · arrows map responsibilities, not entire excerpts
